description: Land Acquisition -Thalangamuwa (Part) Naula D/S Division, Matlae District - Supplement No. 56 and 15 in Topo PP 18 of Moragolla, Naula D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for a public purpose. It includes descriptions of land types, lot numbers, claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the "Land Gazettes" category for land and property-related matters.
